acceptance_stubs.user_intent: Eliminate all AI-slop colorful gradients and rainbow modes; enforce luxury deep monochrome dark-mode UI (#000000, #0a0a0c, #141416, #ffffff, #a1a1aa) with crisp 1px borders.
acceptance_stubs.observable_outcome: Application background renders true black #000000, elevated panels use #0a0a0c and #141416, all text is high-contrast white #ffffff or secondary zinc #a1a1aa. All 6 colorful modes (matrix_green, amber, cyberpunk_neon, truecolor, rgb_ansi) are stripped or defaulted to high-contrast monochrome.
acceptance_stubs.verification_method: Inspect computed DOM styles and CSS custom properties; verify WCAG AA contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 across all text elements; ensure zero saturated color backgrounds.

acceptance_stubs.user_intent: Implement professional graph constellation visualization with fine interconnected lines and technical pill stickers inspired by reference architecture (Cortex, Quant, Aelf, Meeton).
acceptance_stubs.observable_outcome: Viewport shows node graph representation of processing pipeline (Source -> Decoder -> Preflight -> Kernel -> Viewport) with fine connecting lines; technical status stickers (TIER, FPS, RESOLUTION, SANDBOX) render in header and telemetry drawers.
acceptance_stubs.verification_method: Verify SVG/Canvas rendering of node graph; assert technical sticker badges contain real-time values; verify clean typography and no layout overflow.

acceptance_stubs.user_intent: Fix video pipeline: previously inputted video gave no output. Video must decode frames and render real-time ASCII characters.
acceptance_stubs.observable_outcome: User selects an MP4 or WebM video file; video element mounts and plays; requestVideoFrameCallback extracts frames continuously to offscreen canvas; ASCII characters update in real time on the main canvas viewport at up to 60 FPS.
acceptance_stubs.verification_method: Load test video in Playwright; assert frame counter advances > 10 frames within 1 second and AsciiCanvas output is non-empty.

acceptance_stubs.user_intent: Fix image pipeline: image selection must instantly convert and produce high-contrast ASCII art in the viewport.
acceptance_stubs.observable_outcome: User uploads PNG, JPEG, or WebP image; image preflight downsamples buffer to prevent OOM; rasterizer produces full ASCII string matching grid columns and rows; char count and render time display in telemetry sticker.
acceptance_stubs.verification_method: Upload test image; assert image converts within 200ms and asciiText is rendered with non-zero length in DOM.

acceptance_stubs.user_intent: Display a smooth, professional loading animation when the application interface initializes.
acceptance_stubs.observable_outcome: On startup, app shows a high-end monochrome matrix/cascade loader (progress indicator, hardware tier detection step, sealed sandbox confirmation) for 1.2-1.8 seconds, then smoothly transitions to the workspace with exactly one orchestrated reveal moment.
acceptance_stubs.verification_method: Verify AsciiLoader displays during initial load phase; assert transition completes cleanly without layout shift or stuck spinner.

acceptance_stubs.user_intent: Operate strictly as a native Tauri desktop application for macOS, Windows, and Android, not a generic web page.
acceptance_stubs.observable_outcome: App handles native drag-and-drop file paths, camera permission negotiation (Info.plist / WebView2 / AndroidManifest), and IPC communication with Rust backend with zero runtime crashes.
acceptance_stubs.verification_method: Verify tauri-bridge correctly identifies platform capabilities; verify camera access dialog and least-privilege capability schema.

acceptance_stubs.user_intent: Survive edge-case failures: corrupt video codecs, rapid tab switching, 4K/8K images, and camera locks without crashing.
acceptance_stubs.observable_outcome: Unsupported codecs show inline 'CODEC_UNSUPPORTED' sticker; rapid 10Hz tab switching cancels prior video loops cleanly without detached canvas leaks; 8K images clamp to 2048px without thread freeze.
acceptance_stubs.verification_method: Run automated stress tests in Vitest and Playwright simulating edge-case failure inputs.
